intro: This policy explains how the JEELIVE.AI mobile app uses account, learning and Rapid Fire data. The app uses your existing JEELIVE website account for academic services; Rapid Fire is a linked companion service.

sections.title: Account and sign-in
sections.body: Your phone number and PIN are sent over HTTPS to the JEELIVE account service when you sign in or sign up. The website policy describes server-side PIN hashing. The app does not save your PIN. Session credentials and short-lived access tokens are used to keep your account connected. Phone-and-PIN access is not OTP verification of phone ownership.

sections.title: Learning and game records
sections.body: JEELIVE processes your selected exams, test attempts, answers, results, learning history and issue reports to provide the service. The companion backend stores linked Rapid Fire profiles, game outcomes, earned coins, cosmetics, streaks, friend-match history and revision progress. Leaderboards and multiplayer activities can show your game identity and performance to participating users. Earned game coins are not money.

sections.title: Information on this device
sections.body: The app keeps account-scoped drafts so interrupted work can be resumed. Original question images may be cached in encrypted app storage. Cached images are evicted as space is needed and are cleared when you sign out; unsynced drafts are kept or discarded according to your sign-out choice. Downloaded public branding and fonts may remain cached. Loading diagnostics contain only bounded timing/count aggregates in memory, not phone numbers, questions, answers or URLs. They are shared only when you choose Share.

sections.title: How data is used and processed
sections.body: Information is used to authenticate your account, synchronize your learning, operate games, investigate reported problems and maintain service reliability. The JEELIVE account/academic service, companion backend and their hosting/storage infrastructure process the information needed to deliver these functions. Network and request metadata can be processed for operation and abuse prevention. Opening an external website or your email app is subject to that service's own privacy practices.

sections.title: Device features
sections.body: The current app plays short sound effects and may use vibration. It does not offer microphone recording or require broad access to your photos, external storage or screen overlays. A permission in another app, including Expo Go used for development, does not describe the permissions of the JEELIVE standalone app.

sections.title: Retention and your choices
sections.body: Account, academic and game records are retained to operate your account and show your learning history. Device drafts can be discarded and cached images can be removed by signing out. Short-lived companion access grants expire automatically. Account deletion must remove or irreversibly anonymize associated personal records across both services; any legally necessary retention must be explained before processing. Device sign-out alone does not delete server records.

sections.title: Account deletion availability
sections.body: PIN-confirmed direct deletion is not currently available because the JEELIVE account service has not supplied an account-deletion API. The app cannot safely delete only companion data and claim the website account was deleted. The account-deletion page shows this limitation without collecting a PIN or reporting false success. Do not send your PIN by email. Contact the privacy support address below for privacy questions; an email does not itself complete account deletion.

sections.title: Privacy contact and updates
sections.body: For privacy questions or concerns, contact Abhishek@billpe.com. Do not include your PIN, passwords or session tokens. Material changes to the app's processing or deletion capability will be reflected in this policy and the account-deletion information. The update date identifies this version, not a claim of regulatory approval.

deletion.title: Delete account
deletion.status: Direct deletion is not available yet
deletion.explanation: The website account service does not currently expose an account-deletion operation. No PIN is collected here and no account or learning data will be removed by this page.
deletion.scope: A complete deletion must cover your JEELIVE website identity, academic records and sessions, linked Rapid Fire profile/game data and app-held personal data. Signing out or deleting only local game records is not complete account deletion.
deletion.next: The website backend must enable an authenticated deletion operation before PIN-confirmed deletion can be offered safely. This page will not display a Delete button or a success message until the real flow is implemented and verified.
